chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Saeed ibn Janaah, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, did not create a creature smaller than the mosquito, and the Jarjas is smaller than the mosquito, and that which we call Al-Wala'a is smaller than the Jarjas, and there is nothing that the elephant has except that it is in it, similar to it, and it is preferred over the elephant by having two wings.

key_terms.الْجِرْجِسُ: A small insect, smaller than a mosquito
key_terms.الْوَلَعَ: A very small insect, smaller than the Jarjas

ai.seo_question: What is the smallest creature created by Allah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (as) illustrates the diversity of creation by comparing the mosquito, Jarjas, and Al-Wala'a, noting that the latter possesses all the features of an elephant but is distinguished by its wings. This description highlights the intricate design and micro-level complexity within the macrocosm, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on the signs of God in the natural world. The comparison serves as a metaphor for how immense qualities can reside within minute forms, a concept often explored in Shia tafsir and philosophy.

en.hubeali: H 14796 – Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Saeed Bin Janaah, from one of our companions, who has said: Abu Abdullahasws has said:

‘Allahazwj has not Created a creature smaller than the mosquito, and Al-Jarjas is smaller than the mosquito, and that which we call Al-Wala’a is smaller than Al-Jarjas, and there is nothing which the elephant has except that it is in it, similar to it, and it is better than the elephant by having two wings’.
